Monitoring: Inspect field once per week during vegetative, flowering and early fruiting stage.
When symptoms are found inspect twice per week.
Search for galleries on young leaves and tunnels on young fruits caused by larvae.
Look for young larvae in the tunnels which are creamy-greenish with a dark head but later turn to pinkish- green.
Search for adult moths hiding between the leaves during the day.
Adults are filiform, silverish-grey with black spots on inner wings.
If 5-10 leaves with tunnels or larvae or adult moths are found /acre consider taking control action.
